desa.title: The Hamlet Head's Child
desa.premise: The child of a hamlet head in a Javanese village, weighing duty to tradition and community against personal curiosity.

lyr.title: The Sail Father Stitched
lyr.premise: The child of a Bugis fisher on the South Sulawesi coast, between the family's sea inheritance and school in the city.

pcn.title: The Shop in Pecinan
pcn.premise: A Peranakan Chinese girl in Semarang growing up among the family shop, the ancestral altar, and neighbors of other faiths.

tli.title: Hands That Speak
tli.premise: A Deaf child in Jakarta learning sign language and navigating school, a hearing family, and a community of her own.

flr.title: A Call from Hong Kong
flr.premise: A child in Flores raised by her grandmother while her mother works in Hong Kong and appears only through a phone screen.

ptn.title: The Blue Headscarf in Pattani
ptn.premise: A Malay Muslim girl in southern Thailand whose school is in Thai while her home speaks Malay.

bnt.title: The Eldest on the Riverbank
bnt.premise: The eldest child of a single mother in a dense riverbank settlement in Jakarta, carrying responsibility before her time.

dyk.title: Tiwah on the Banks of the Kahayan
dyk.premise: A Dayak Ngaju teen who follows Kaharingan in Central Kalimantan, weighing ancestral custom, school, and the changing forest.

prk.title: Rubber on the Perak Estate
prk.premise: A Tamil Hindu family's child on a rubber estate in Perak, Malaysia, between Tamil, Malay-language schooling, and hopes for a better life.

mxc.title: Two Kitchens, One Child
mxc.premise: A teenager of Mexican immigrants in Texas who translates the world for her parents while finding a place between two cultures.
